ali-taj.text: (2018) Voted to approve Artesia Live II, a seven-story mixed-use development across from Los Cerritos Center (4-0 vote, Mayor Flowers recused).

source.title: Los Cerritos Community News: On a 4-0 vote, Artesia Council approves Artesia Live II (Feb 2018)

rene-j-trevino.text: (2018) Then a former commissioner, joined opponents of the seven-story Artesia Live II mixed-use project at the council hearing; per LCCN he emailed around a petition against high-density developments.

source.title: Los Cerritos Community News: On a 4-0 vote, Artesia Council approves Artesia Live II (Feb 2018)

rene-j-trevino.text: (2018) As a candidate, sent a mailer claiming 'CRIME HAS RISEN 46% OVERALL IN ARTESIA' and 'There has been no serious response from our city council.' The Sheriff's Department disputed his numbers.

source.title: Los Cerritos Community News: Artesia Council Candidate Rene Trevino Claims Crime is Up in City (Oct 2018)

notes: Artesia's city site posts no 2026 candidate statements, and no 2026 coverage was found. Only older 2018 items exist.
